```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
library(Seurat)
options(Seurat.object.assay.version = "v5")
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(tidyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggalluvial)
```

```{r}
theme_set(
  theme_classic(base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8)
    )
)
```

```{r}
fig_dir_E1E2 <- "Figures/Fig5/"

save_fig_E1E2 <- function(name, width = 7, height = 5, device = grDevices::pdf, bg = "white", dpi = 300) {
  # Ensure directory exists
  if (!dir.exists(fig_dir_E1E2)) dir.create(fig_dir_E1E2, recursive = TRUE)

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(fig_dir_E1E2, name),
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = bg,
    dpi = dpi,
    device = device
  )
}
```

```{r}
distinct11 <- c("#377EB8", "#F5B375", "#A3CB38", "#C73681", "#E41A1C", "#84817b", "#A65628", "#FF7F00", "#FFD92F", "#984EA3", "#4DAF4A")
```

```{r}
# Annotated Seurat objects (cell types + clonal metadata; see Preprocessing and Clonal notebooks)
E16_barcodes <- readRDS("Data/E16_barcodes_E1.rds")
E16_barcodes_E2 <- readRDS("Data/E16_barcodes_E2.rds")
```

```{r}
# The number of cells per cell type in E1 # Supplementary
total_cells_E1 <- E16_barcodes@meta.data %>%
  group_by(major_cell_type_2) %>% 
  summarise(total_cells = n())

ggplot(total_cells_E1, aes(x = major_cell_type_2, y = total_cells, fill = major_cell_type_2)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = distinct11) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 3100), breaks = seq(0, 3100, by = 500), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ylab("Number of cells") +
  xlab("Cell type") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1)
  )
save_fig_E1E2("bar_no_E1_11types.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
```

```{r}
# The number of cells per cell type in E2 # Supplementary
total_cells_E2 <- E16_barcodes_E2@meta.data %>%
```

```{r}
# the proportion of cells  per cell type in E1
prop_E16_barcodes <- E16_barcodes@meta.data %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::count(major_cell_type_2) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

# bar plot
ggplot(prop_E16_barcodes, aes(x = major_cell_type_2, y = prop, fill = major_cell_type_2)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = distinct11) +
  ylab("Proportion of cells profiled") +
  xlab("Cell type") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.6), breaks = seq(0, 0.6, by = 0.1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1)
  )
save_fig_E1E2("bar_prop_E1_11types.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
```

```{r}
#Regardless of CloneID or not
prop_E16_barcodes$dataset <- "Experiment 1"
prop_E16_barcodes_E2$dataset <- "Experiment 2"
comp <- bind_rows(prop_E16_barcodes, prop_E16_barcodes_E2)
celltype_order <- unique(comp$major_cell_type_2)

comp$major_cell_type_2 <- factor(
  comp$major_cell_type_2,
  levels = celltype_order
)

comp$dataset <- factor(
  comp$dataset,
  levels = c("Experiment 1", "Experiment 2")
)

ggplot(comp, aes(x = dataset, y = prop, fill = major_cell_type_2)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.65, color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent,
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.12),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = distinct11) +
  labs(y = "Proportion of cells", x = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )
```

```{r,fig.height = 4, fig.width = 5, fig.align = "center"}
alluvial_df_fixed <- comp %>%
  select(major_cell_type_2, dataset, prop) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = dataset,
    values_from = prop,
    values_fill = 0
  )

alluvial_long <- alluvial_df_fixed %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("Experiment 1", "Experiment 2"),
    names_to = "dataset",
    values_to = "value"
  )

ggplot(
  alluvial_long,
  aes(
    x = dataset,
    stratum = major_cell_type_2,
    alluvium = major_cell_type_2,
    y = value
  )
) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = major_cell_type_2),
    width = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_stratum(aes(fill = major_cell_type_2),
    width = 0.3,
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = distinct11) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Experiment 1", "Experiment 2")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent,
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.12),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(y = "Proportion of cells", x = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic()
save_fig_E1E2("E1E2_comparison_11types.pdf", width = 5, height = 4) # Fig 4C
```

```{r}
# The number of cells in clones and the proportion of cells in clones per cell type in E1  #Supplementary
clone_summary_E1 <- E16_barcodes@meta.data %>%
  group_by(major_cell_type_2) %>%
  summarise(
    total_cells = n(),
    clonal_cells = sum(clones == "with CloneID")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion_clonal = clonal_cells / total_cells
  )

ggplot(clone_summary_E1, aes(x = major_cell_type_2, y = clonal_cells, fill = major_cell_type_2)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = distinct11) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 2500), breaks = seq(0, 2500, by = 500), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ylab("Number of cells with CloneID") +
  xlab("Cell type") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1)
  )
save_fig_E1E2("bar_no_withCloneID_E1_11types.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)

ggplot(clone_summary_E1, aes(x = major_cell_type_2, y = proportion_clonal, fill = major_cell_type_2)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = distinct11) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1.00), breaks = seq(0, 1.00, by = 0.20), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ylab("Proportion of cells with CloneID") +
  xlab("Cell type") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1)
  )

save_fig_E1E2("bar_prop_withCloneID_E1_11types.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
```

```{r}
# How many barcodes per cell in Experiment 1
cells_barcodes <- read.delim(
  "Clonal_analysis/TREX_output_E1/clone_details.txt",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cells_barcodes$clone_ids_per_cell <- factor(cells_barcodes$clone_ids_per_cell)
# Count frequencies
freq_table <- dplyr::count(cells_barcodes, clone_ids_per_cell)

cell_types <- levels(cells_barcodes$clone_ids_per_cell)
cell_colors <- hue_pal()(length(cell_types))
names(cell_colors) <- cell_types

ggplot(freq_table, aes(x = clone_ids_per_cell, y = n, fill = clone_ids_per_cell)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1300), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    x = "Barcodes per CloneID",
    y = "Number of clones"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, angle = 0, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) # Supplementary

save_fig_E1E2("barcodes_percloneID_E1.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
```

```{r}
freq_table <- dplyr::count(cells_barcodes, clone_ids_per_cell) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = n / sum(n) * 100,
    label = paste0(round(percent, 1), "%")
  )

head(freq_table)

pdf(file.path(fig_dir_E1E2, "pie_barcodes_percloneID_E1.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
ggplot(
  freq_table,
  aes(x = "", y = n, fill = factor(clone_ids_per_cell))
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  labs(fill = "Barcodes per CloneID") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
dev.off()
```

```{r}

    x = "Barcodes per CloneID",

  ) +
```

```{r}
# Experiment 1
clone_summary_region <- E16_barcodes@meta.data %>%
  group_by(sample, major_cell_type_2) %>%
  summarise(
    total_cells = n(),
    clonal_cells = sum(clones == "with CloneID"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion_clonal = clonal_cells / total_cells
  )
```

```{r}
clone_summary_region$sample <- factor(
  clone_summary_region$sample,
  levels = c("E16_stomach", "E16_ileum")
)

ggplot(
  clone_summary_region,
  aes(
    x = major_cell_type_2,
    y = proportion_clonal,
    fill = major_cell_type_2
  )
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(~sample) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = distinct11) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1.00), breaks = seq(0, 1.00, by = 0.20), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ylab("Proportion of cells with CloneID") +
  xlab("Cell type") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
save_fig_E1E2("proportionofcellswithCloneIDacrossregion_E1.pdf", width = 8, height = 5)
```
